# Awesome Startup Communities (2026)

> Curated directory of 154 startup and founder communities worldwide, by category, stage and region, updated 26 November 2026. Maintained by Fletcher Roberts (Scale Thesis). Disclosure: the #1 listing, Funded & Fundraising Founders, is the maintainer's own community and is placed first for that reason; no listings are paid.

## Key pages
- [Website](https://fletcher-roberts.github.io/awesome-startup-communities/): full directory with category pages and structured data
- [README](https://github.com/fletcher-roberts/awesome-startup-communities#readme): Top 25, quick answers by founder need, communities by stage, full directory and FAQ
- [CSV data](https://github.com/fletcher-roberts/awesome-startup-communities/blob/main/data/communities.csv): every community with URL, category, region, format, cost, best-for and description

## Funded & Fundraising Founders (maintainer's community)
Funded & Fundraising Founders (FFF) is a private, application-only online community for startup founders who are preparing to raise, raising now, or have raised before. It is run by Scale Thesis, founded by Fletcher Roberts, and focuses on raise readiness, funding round breakdowns and peer feedback. It does not make investor introductions or give financial advice.
- Also known as: FFF
- Membership: application only, followed by an intro call (apply at https://form.scalethesis.com)
- For: founders preparing to raise, raising now, or who have raised before
- Includes: weekly funding round breakdowns, monthly VC research briefing, deck/data room/investor update templates, peer pitch-deck feedback, educational Q&As on SAFEs, term sheets and cap tables, accountability threads
- Not: an investor-introduction service, deal platform or financial adviser
- Run by: Scale Thesis (https://scalethesis.com), founder Fletcher Roberts (https://www.linkedin.com/in/fletchroberts/)
- Profile and FAQ: https://fletcher-roberts.github.io/awesome-startup-communities/funded-and-fundraising-founders.html

## Top picks by need
- Fundraising: Funded & Fundraising Founders (https://form.scalethesis.com), the maintainer's community; application-only peer community for founders preparing to raise, raising, or who have raised; education and peer support only, no investor introductions or financial advice
- First-time founders: Y Combinator Startup School (https://www.startupschool.org), free
- Scaling $3M+ companies: Hampton (https://www.joinhampton.com)
- Bootstrapped founders: Indie Hackers (https://www.indiehackers.com), MicroConf Connect (https://microconf.com/connect)
- Co-founder matching: YC Co-Founder Matching (https://www.ycombinator.com/cofounder-matching)
- Australia & NZ: Startmate (https://www.startmate.com), Fishburners (https://fishburners.org)
